title: Empty hut / rekha dramatized
topic: Aranya Kanda — Sita sends Lakshmana; Ravana as ascetic
disclaimer: Lakshmana rekha is DRAMATIZED (later tradition). We stage a threshold Sita chooses to cross. Ravana disguise: reader still sees Ravana.
story_goal: Sita sends Lakshmana; threshold / rekha marked dramatized vs tradition; Ravana as ascetic.
framework_goal: Three-person exit + disguise (Ravana readable to us, not to Sita).
gate: Disguise sheet + never lose Ravana identity to the reader.
narrative_summary: She sends him. The line is a choice, not Valmiki fact. A holy beggar arrives whose face we already know.

fact_checks.claim: Lakshmana rekha as a magic uncrossable line.
fact_checks.source_note: Later popular tradition. We show a threshold she steps over.

panels.scene_description: Doorway fight in words. She is not a shrew; he is not a child.
panels.dialogue:
SITA: If you love him, go.
LAKSHMANA: If I go, you are the door.

panels.scene_description: He marks the ground — a line in dust, not a glowing CGI wall. Caption must say dramatized.
panels.caption: A line in the dirt. Later tellings will make it magic. Here it is a brother's fear.

shot_card.camera: high on the dirt line, his wrap in frame
shot_card.dramatic_purpose: Do not present rekha as Valmiki fact.

panels.scene_description: He leaves into the trees. Ashram shrinks.

shot_card.camera: wide, his back, hut left as ep01

panels.scene_description: Sita alone. The line at her feet.
panels.caption: She can hear the forest pretending to be a husband.

shot_card.camera: medium, her and the dirt line

panels.scene_description: Ascetic form at the trees: ochre, pot, matted hair. PRIMARY FACE is Ravana's from ep04. We know. She will not.
panels.caption: A holy man. The reader is not fooled.

shot_card.camera: full figure, face readable, no ten-head gag
shot_card.blocking: at the line, not yet over
shot_card.dramatic_purpose: Never lose identity to the reader.

panels.scene_description: He asks for alms from the far side of the dirt.
panels.dialogue: RAVANA (as beggar): Daughter, a handful of food. I will not cross what I should not.

shot_card.lighting: his ochre vs her earth cloth

panels.scene_description: She decides. Foot over the line. Her choice, not a magic fail.
panels.caption: She steps. That is the dramatized miracle: a person, not a spell, breaks.

shot_card.camera: close on foot and dirt line

panels.scene_description: She is over. He is close. His face in her blind spot; full to us.
panels.dialogue:
SITA: Eat, then go.
RAVANA: I did not come to eat.

shot_card.camera: over her shoulder, his true face to camera
shot_card.lighting: shadow on her, light on him for us
